1c5b2cf4-fcdd-4796-b816-245d55ff06d9.name: Stade Grande Ourse
1c5b2cf4-fcdd-4796-b816-245d55ff06d9.description: This red run drops from 1,730 m to 1,550 m over 630 m. It is a race stadium and starts at the top of the Planeys chairlift.

70fe2362-7382-4868-9736-7b573b2ee586.name: Stade de la combe
70fe2362-7382-4868-9736-7b573b2ee586.description: This red run drops from 1,710 m to 1,430 m over 1.2 km. It is a race stadium and ends at the Poireaux 2 drag lift.

91d40bff-ee87-4b0a-b0e6-0eb0d678c626.name: Stade de la pointe
91d40bff-ee87-4b0a-b0e6-0eb0d678c626.description: This red run drops from 1,810 m to 1,670 m over 500 m. It is a race stadium and starts at the top of the Pointe du Chéry chairlift.

b0a7df87-e0d3-45b7-9374-da5bd4efebaf.name: Stade du Ranfoilly
b0a7df87-e0d3-45b7-9374-da5bd4efebaf.description: This red run drops from 1,790 m to 1,430 m over 1.6 km. It is a race stadium and starts at the top of the Ranfoilly Express chairlift.

daaa7160-8226-4f6d-97fb-ff514c969f46.name: Séraussaix
daaa7160-8226-4f6d-97fb-ff514c969f46.description: This blue run drops from 1,750 m to 1,650 m over 2.0 km. It runs from the top of the Séraussaix chairlift down to the Proclou chairlift.

fbf8da3d-082d-4ccf-afd2-b03b6a77f1c2.name: TANNES
fbf8da3d-082d-4ccf-afd2-b03b6a77f1c2.description: This red run drops from 1,770 m to 1,510 m over 1.1 km. It ends at the Prolays chairlift and has a few steeper pitches.

44b42fad-a513-486d-9ec2-03c84ebdba71.name: TETRAS
44b42fad-a513-486d-9ec2-03c84ebdba71.description: This blue run drops from 1,740 m to 1,460 m over 1.8 km. It runs from the top of the Baron drag lift down to the Zore chairlift.

c79b3646-c373-45fa-9418-0d784e6aa618.name: TRASHERS
c79b3646-c373-45fa-9418-0d784e6aa618.description: This green run drops from 1,820 m to 1,790 m over 170 m. It starts at the top of the Trashers drag lift.

71394b74-c556-40a8-af32-65023a649242.name: TULIPE
71394b74-c556-40a8-af32-65023a649242.description: This blue run drops from 1,790 m to 1,400 m over 1.9 km. It starts at the top of the Ranfoilly Express chairlift.

82163ede-6247-45dd-bbc5-a49ce0b7bbcc.name: The Stash sous le Télésiège
82163ede-6247-45dd-bbc5-a49ce0b7bbcc.description: This blue run drops from 1,790 m to 1,640 m over 640 m.

95636597-cb68-42f9-82ac-7169d1ded9d8.name: Tour du lac
95636597-cb68-42f9-82ac-7169d1ded9d8.description: This snowshoe trail is a 2.9 km loop between 1,060 m and 1,090 m.

bc3c46c7-81d3-4511-a29f-b0f1635be1a8.name: VAINEUVE
bc3c46c7-81d3-4511-a29f-b0f1635be1a8.description: This red run drops from 1,870 m to 1,730 m over 460 m. It is steep in places.

ff65101e-0f45-40fd-9f2d-5bd4861a2dbe.name: VAUTNA
ff65101e-0f45-40fd-9f2d-5bd4861a2dbe.description: This red run drops from 2,140 m to 1,910 m over 1.2 km. It starts at the top of the Cases chairlift.

cfc09fb4-2157-4fa1-be39-54f786640cba.name: VIEUX CHENE
cfc09fb4-2157-4fa1-be39-54f786640cba.description: This blue run drops from 1,230 m to 1,170 m over 340 m. It starts at the top of the Vieux Chêne drag lift.

d5aff7ba-d69d-4096-b01d-b1ee554ffca5.name: VIOLETTE
d5aff7ba-d69d-4096-b01d-b1ee554ffca5.description: This blue run drops from 1,600 m to 1,390 m over 1.3 km. It runs from the top of the Chavannes Express chairlift down to the Ranfoilly Express chairlift.

08e9f8d5-0c71-4afa-8a5d-69535135fd23.name: VOROSSES
08e9f8d5-0c71-4afa-8a5d-69535135fd23.description: This blue run drops from 1,510 m to 1,210 m over 1.3 km. It starts at the top of the Turche drag lift.

1c17bc6c-b9d1-4937-aa58-baab60ddfff1.name: Variante Cuboré
1c17bc6c-b9d1-4937-aa58-baab60ddfff1.description: This red run drops from 2,180 m to 2,060 m over 500 m. It starts at the top of the Cuboré Montriond chairlift and is steep in places.

33251712-347b-4e8f-82d9-269540cfe284.name: Variante Tetras
33251712-347b-4e8f-82d9-269540cfe284.description: This blue run drops from 1,590 m to 1,540 m over 270 m.

2fed19d9-7a4a-4eaa-b831-a66c02e0901a.name: Vautna Bas
2fed19d9-7a4a-4eaa-b831-a66c02e0901a.description: This red run drops from 1,910 m to 1,730 m over 1.2 km. It ends at the Cases chairlift.

192c73ae-8b74-4c4b-b21e-2f1f63f29262.name: Village des Enfants
192c73ae-8b74-4c4b-b21e-2f1f63f29262.description: This green run is 60 m long and almost flat, at about 1,810 m. It ends at the Dromonts 2 drag lift.

09d59a1c-9f75-49cd-b8f4-ff796257a567.name: Village des Lindarets
09d59a1c-9f75-49cd-b8f4-ff796257a567.description: This blue run is 310 m long and almost flat, at about 1,490 m.

9ca427d9-87e4-4c32-8fa6-2f4be97f9c71.name: YETI
9ca427d9-87e4-4c32-8fa6-2f4be97f9c71.description: This black run drops from 1,650 m to 1,400 m over 830 m. It starts at the top of the Rosta chairlift and has a few steeper pitches.

99a80c6d-7adf-415b-8034-7bdb52c16f78.name: ZORE
99a80c6d-7adf-415b-8034-7bdb52c16f78.description: This blue run drops from 1,740 m to 1,440 m over 1.4 km. It starts at the top of the Zore chairlift.

a26d209d-6fe9-46f1-8c87-e2f16b29648c.name: Zone Débutants
a26d209d-6fe9-46f1-8c87-e2f16b29648c.description: This green run drops from 1,530 m to 1,500 m over 230 m. It is a beginner area and starts at the top of the Viking moving carpet.

86285e67-c50d-46c1-b047-0762ec811157.name: Zone de Speed Riding
86285e67-c50d-46c1-b047-0762ec811157.description: This black run drops from 1,410 m to 1,250 m over 500 m. It is a zone set aside for speed riding, which is skiing with a small paraglider wing.

ae9639fe-92a6-404e-b7af-cbdaa2c4f76c.name: Zone de bosses Chavannes
ae9639fe-92a6-404e-b7af-cbdaa2c4f76c.description: This red run drops from 1,550 m to 1,490 m over 290 m. It is a mogul zone and ends at the Croix chairlift.

3a01a952-f090-4eae-a774-16a9d112164f.name: accès Pré-Favre
3a01a952-f090-4eae-a774-16a9d112164f.description: This blue run is 70 m long and almost flat, at about 1,180 m. It is a link run and ends at the Pré Favre chairlift.
